name: colord-scale
description: Whole-package style run on the same vendored colord corpus: 20 production files, 206 arithmetic edits, all 102 upstream tests. Measures per-mutant cost where the default workload (10 mutants) measures start-up cost.

scopeNotes.familyChoice: Arithmetic only. Stryker's BooleanLiteral operator also rewrites `!x` to `x`, which Oximut does not generate, so every file with a `!isPresent(..)`/`!match` guard (cmyk, lab, xyz, rgb, ...) breaks mutant-set equality when both families are compared. Both tools declare the same single family instead (Oximut --mutators arithmetic; Stryker excludes BooleanLiteral); the equality gate is unchanged.

excludedFiles.src/get/getPerceivedDifference.ts: 90 mutants on both sides but 13 edits differ textually: Stryker reprints the mutated binary expression (dropping redundant parentheses and line breaks) while Oximut edits only the operator.
excludedFiles.src/colorModels/hex.ts: Textual divergence from redundant parentheses (1 Stryker-only edit, 2 Oximut-only).
excludedFiles.src/colorModels/hsl.ts: Redundant-parenthesis divergence (6 edits per tool differ).
excludedFiles.src/colorModels/hwb.ts: Redundant-parenthesis divergence (6 edits per tool differ).
excludedFiles.src/colorModels/lch.ts: Redundant-parenthesis divergence (4 edits per tool differ).
excludedFiles.src/helpers.ts: Stryker mutates `%` (2 edits) which Oximut does not generate.
excludedFiles.src/plugins/minify.ts: Oximut mutates string-concatenation `+` (2 edits) which Stryker does not.
excludedFiles.src/random.ts: Math.random(): outcomes are not a stable cross-tool comparison.
excludedFiles.src/constants.ts: Module-level (static) edits are handled differently by the two tools' coverage models.

scopeNotes.method: Mutant sets were compared offline by the sha256 of each exact edited file (the harness's identity): `oximut --list --mutators arithmetic` against Stryker 10.1.1's instrumenter (ArithmeticOperator mutants). Outcomes can only be confirmed by a native run.
